document.title: The gap between rich and poor
document.question:
Some people believe that governments have a responsibility to reduce the gap between rich and poor citizens. Others argue that individuals should be responsible for improving their own financial situation.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
